_doc: Cross-language envelope parity oracle. Every adapter (openclaw, hermes, nanobot, moltis, ironclaw, zeroclaw) emits the same envelope shape under matching failure modes. Each entry below pins the `error` code (exact-string match) and the `recovery_hint` template (exact-structure match after key-sort). `message` is FREE-FORM prose — adapters MAY vary the human-readable string; the parity tests do NOT pin it. `details` MAY carry transport-specific values (trace_ids, timestamps); parity tests assert STRUCTURE and the field NAMES that R2 mandates (`field`, `problem`, `consumer`, etc.). See ADR-0011 for the full contract. Adding/removing a failure-mode entry MUST happen via ADR amendment — each adapter's test suite reads this file and asserts coverage.

not_registered._when: creds file or config.json missing under ${KLODI_HOME}

klodi_home_missing._when: ${KLODI_HOME} directory absent or unwritable for tools with on-disk side effects

connection_not_ready._when: NATS client not connected — transport down, no responders, or connect failed

consumer_missing_notifications._when: server-managed notifications consumer absent at subscribe time

consumer_missing_channels._when: server-managed channels consumer absent at subscribe time

invalid_request_missing_field._when: required field absent from args (caught by adapter guard)

invalid_request_wrong_type._when: required field is wrong type (string expected, integer received; bad UUID)

invalid_request_empty._when: non-empty-string field receives an empty string

marketplace_passthrough_listing_not_owne._when: server rejects state-mutating tool because caller does not own the target listing (passthrough path; recovery_hint stays null per architect open Q2 conservative default)

marketplace_error_unknown_code._when: server returns an error code outside the closed R2 vocabulary; adapter collapses to marketplace_error and preserves the original code under details.marketplace_error_code

internal_error_generic._when: adapter raises an exception outside the categorised set (JSON decode, panic, unexpected throw)
